sentence: Drop reddit posts whose title starts with 'How many of you are' — these are subreddit-pointer meta-posts with no story content.
rationale: Feedback item (2): the title is just a pointer to a different subreddit, no actual news.

sentence: Drop reddit posts whose title begins 'What a [adjective] thing'. Headlines too vague to know what they're about without clicking.
rationale: Feedback item (4): vague reddit emote headlines that require a click to know what they reference.

sentence: Drop any article whose title contains 'open thread' — these are recurring discussion meta-posts, not stories.
rationale: Feedback item (5): 'Tuesday May 26th – Open Thread' shouldn't make it in.

rationale: Feedback item (7): WorldNews Live Thread for Ukraine has no place in a daily edition.

sentence: Drop article whose title looks like a podcast episode pointer.

sentence: Ban pitchfork.com. Album reviews are not in the editorial lane I want for this paper.
